title: Dev Setup and Daily Workflow
subtitle: Get the curata repo running locally, plus the restarts that aren't obvious.

components.body: Start here on day one. Source of truth is `CLAUDE.md`, `dev.sh`, `package.json` and `.env.example` in the repo root.

items.title: Run ./dev.sh
items.detail: Starts Postgres in Docker, creates .env from .env.example, installs deps, runs pnpm generate, pushes the Prisma schema, starts the dev server.

items.title: Keep AUTH_MODE=none locally
items.detail: AUTH_MODE switches all auth behavior: none, tailscale, oauth, clerk. none uses the first org, no login. See src/middleware.ts.

items.title: Connect your agent
items.detail: Point Claude Code at the local MCP endpoint under /api/mcp so you read and write pages the way users do.

components.code:
pnpm dev          # Next.js dev server (webpack)
pnpm generate     # Prisma client + kazam SDK/renderer + generated docs
pnpm test         # Vitest, tests/*.test.ts, files run sequentially
pnpm lint         # fix before opening a PR
pnpm storybook    # needed for help-video captures
docker compose up # Postgres plus the app in Docker

components.body:
- Schema change? Restart the dev server. It holds the Prisma client in memory. After editing `prisma/schema.prisma`, run `pnpm generate` and restart `pnpm dev`, or writes fail with `Unknown argument` / `PrismaClientValidationError`.
- `.bin/kazam` is a committed binary, not a symlink. After a kazam change: `cargo build --release`, copy `target/release/kazam` to `curata/.bin/kazam`, then `pnpm generate`.
- Don't hand-edit `src/generated/**`. It's build output and lint skips it.
- Keep tests safe to run sequentially. `vitest.config.ts` sets `fileParallelism: false`.
- claude.ai's MCP connector caches tool schemas. After changing MCP tools, refresh the connector in claude.ai settings or dogfood agents see stale tools.

The repo uses kazam for tasks and context, with state in `.kazam/`. Read `.kazam/ctx/anatomy.tsv` before exploring, run `kazam ctx bugs --file <path>` before fixing an error, close tasks as you commit. Full rules in `.claude/rules/kazam-workspace.md`.
